title: Final Neutrino Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the kinetic energy of the neutrino as 235.6 MeV.

title: Final Muon Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the kinetic energy of the muon as 152.4 MeV.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the application of conservation of energy in the decay process.

title: Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply momentum conservation principles to relate the momenta of the muon and neutrino.

title: Correct Use of Rest Energies
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the rest energies of the K meson and muon in their calculations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all energies are expressed in consistent units (MeV).

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign errors when applying conservation laws.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be cautious of missing factors when calculating kinetic energies from momentum.
